items.evidence: Log lines 2-129 dispense 5 uL MM into all 96 wells first, then 4 uL primers (132-513), then 1 uL colony (516-1473): a 10 uL reaction with MM before template.
Primer and colony source wells map to the same PCR wells (e.g. A1 to A1, B1 to B1 ... H12 to H12) for all 96, each used once.
One tip used for MM into empty wells then dropped (line 130); a fresh tip picked up and dropped for each primer and each colony; no pipetting without a tip.

Comments record sealing the plate and a Q5 program: 98 C 3 min, 30 cycles of 98 C 10 s / annealing / 72 C 30 s per kb, 72 C 2 min final extension, 4 C hold. The annealing temperature is only given as a primer-dependent range, but that fits the task.

Follows the paper's 10 uL OT-2 reaction with 1 uL colony template added last, and adapts the 9 uL mix to separate Q5 MM and primers, with the assumptions stated in comments; metadata and citation are accurate.

judge.summary: The run log shows a 10 uL reaction in every well: 5 uL Q5 2x master mix, then 4 uL of that colony's primer pair, then 1 uL of colony template. Mapping is one-to-one, tips are fresh per sample and all dropped, and the off-deck sealing and Q5 thermocycling program is recorded in comments. All five items pass.
